entries.text: Idea: Wire an ephemeris signal decoder into the Little Dart's main dashboard for nav-data.
Read "Horizons System": Deep space net has a real-time orbit tracker called Horizons that lists thousands of asteroids.
digging into the Horizons System database on the Wire
entries.why: I need to learn how to fetch clean ephemeris vectors so the Dart doesn't get lost in deep space.

entries.text: Idea: Wire up a small scrap console in the Little Dart dedicated purely to scanning local orbital trajectories.
Read "JPL Solar System Dynamics": The humans have a whole database just for tracking tiny rocks floating around in space.
checking the latest comet count on the wire link
entries.why: My curiosity gauge is at max and I need some fresh cosmic facts.
